parse_protobuf_text_to_message: parse a protobuf text format string into a protobuf message object using text_format.Parse
merge_protobuf_text_into_message: merge protobuf text format fields into an existing message using text_format.Merge
print_message_to_text_string: convert a protobuf message to human-readable text format string using text_format.MessageToString
print_message_with_custom_formatter: print a protobuf message with custom formatting using text_format.MessageToString with message_formatter callback
parse_protobuf_text_with_unknown_fields: parse protobuf text allowing unknown fields using text_format.Parse with allow_unknown_field=True
